37   DISCONTINUED OPERATIONS AND ASSETS HELD FOR SALE
As at the reporting date, the Group was committed to transfer the head lease and the operating assets of Luxury Resort (Pvt) Ltd, a
wholly owned subsidiary of Hayleys PLC, by entering into a binding offer (Contract) by way of a Letter of Intent dated 03rd February
2026 and an addendum to the binding offer dated 11th April 2026 and an Asset Purchase Agreement signed on 16th May 2026,
which comprises the transfer of property, plant & equipment, leasehold rights, intangible assets, and inventories relating to its hotel
operations in the Maldives.

37.3   Losses on impairement of subsidiaries and amounts due from subsidraies recognized in Hayleys PLC
As a result of the committed transfer of head lease and the operating assets of Luxury Resort (Pvt) Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary
of Hayleys PLC, management has assessed that there is uncertainty over the recoverability of its investment and related receivables
as at 31 March 2026. Accordingly, Hayleys PLC has recognised an impairment loss of Rs. 6.88 bn in the Statement of Profit or Loss,
which includes impairment of investments in Luxury Resort (Pvt) Ltd amounting to Rs. 2.96 bn and impairment of balances receivable
from Luxury Resort (Pvt) Ltd amounting to Rs. 3.92 bn.

Capital Management

future development of the business. Capital consists of share capital, reserves, retained earnings and non-controlling interests of the
